raw_segments.text: And the word profane is usually taken in the Scripture for the same with common, and consequently
their contraries, holy and proper, in the kingdom of God must be the same also.
But figuratively, those men also are called holy, that led such godly lives as if they
had forsaken all worldly designs and wholly devoted and given themselves to God.
In the proper sense, that which is made holy by God's appropriating or separating it to
his own use is said to be sanctified by God as the seventh day in the fourth commandment,
and as the elect in the New Testament were said to be sanctified when they were endued
And that which is made holy by the dedication of men and given to God so as to be used onely
in his public service is called also sacred and said to be consecrated as temples and
other houses of public prayer and their utensils, priests and ministers, victims, offerings,
and the external matter of sacraments.
